method.question: Evaluate the operator's proposal: resolve the bracketed (L < H) region by positional superko (PSK) in a layered retrograde loop — Pass 3: retrograde-BFS until a depth with brackets; resolve those to terminal under PSK; repeat Pass 2 for the next layer; expect fewer instances each round. Deliver an ADR (docs/decisions/0021-cycle-resolution-by-superko.md) with: the ruleset statement, the coherence argument (or refutation), measured costs at 3x3 with a projection to 4x3 and 4x4, the relationship to the existing finisher, and a recommendation.
method.subject: The graft under test: k=1 (basic-ko) legality fixpoint with PSK fresh-start values pinned onto the bracketed region, re-propagated by the Bellman operator. Measurements: (1) value-coherence of the graft — where PSK fresh-start diverges from the fixpoint, and whether it ever leaves the bracket; (2) the layer distribution of the fresh-start bracket region at 3x3/4x3/4x4; (3) the layered pinning experiment (does resolving a layer shrink the next, at what rate, and is the propagation PSK-exact); (4) the exactness cost (verify-then-pin phase).

src/t386_shrink.zig.purpose: The layered pinning experiment: fixpoint round 0; then repeat: pin the FRESH-START key (position, side, ko=none, passes=0) of every bracket-valued position at the deepest unresolved layer to its PSK value (artifacts/oracle-3x3.wzo, artifacts/oracle-4x3.wzo), re-converge with pins held, recount. Phase 2 (exactness): pin every fresh-start key whose converged value still differs from the PSK oracle; re-converge; repeat until the table equals the PSK oracle. A 'pin' is one idealized forward PSK solve — the experiment measures solve-COUNT economics, NOT per-solve cost.

findings.question: coherence (a): does PSK diverge only where the fixpoint is undetermined?
findings.verdict: measurement — the coherence fact survives at 4x3
findings.claim: At every reachable legal position x side where the basic-ko fixpoint is single-valued (L == H), the PSK fresh-start value equals it; where L < H the PSK value may differ. If PSK diverged at an L==H position, the graft would change a value the fixpoint already determined.
findings.measurement: 3x3 (control): checked 24,330; divergent (PSK vs clamp(TIE=0,[L,H])) = 680 = 2.80%; ALL 680 at L<H; 0 at L==H; null control (L==H, 0-ko-cluster) 0. Reproduces T380 F-6 exactly. 4x3: checked 635,190 of 643,378 slots (8,188 sides lack PSK value/reachability); divergent 2,792 = 0.44%; ALL at L<H; 0 at L==H; null control 0. Divergent classes: [600,80,0,0] at 3x3, [2,696,96,0,0] at 4x3 (by independent-ko-cluster count) — the bulk of divergence is at positions with no static ko shape (cycle structure created in play), matching T380 F-5's bracket-source finding.
findings.controls: the 3x3 frame reproduces T380 F-6's published numbers exactly; the engine is regression-gated entry-for-entry against the committed 3x3 table (49,428 entries, 0 mismatches).

findings.question: coherence (b) — NEW: is every PSK fresh-start value inside its bracket?
findings.verdict: measurement — the graft never contradicts a bound the table makes
findings.claim: A fresh-start PSK value outside [L,H] would refute the graft's value-coherence (the PSK resolution would contradict a bound the fixpoint already makes). Measured: zero such values at both sizes.
findings.measurement: psk_outside_bracket = 0 at 3x3 (24,330 checked) and 0 at 4x3 (635,190 checked). Combined with F-1: the PSK fresh-start table and the fixpoint agree on every single-valued position and never contradict each other on any position. The strongest measured statement of graft coherence available: 'resolve the undetermined region under PSK' changes nothing determined and never violates a bound.
findings.controls: same instrument as F-1; the 3x3 frame is the control.

findings.question: cost (a): the layer distribution of the fresh-start bracket region
findings.verdict: measurement — bell-shaped, mid-game-heavy; near-terminal and opening layers are small
findings.claim: The 4x4 fresh-start bracket region is not opening-concentrated: it peaks at 10 stones (L10: 434,904 entries) and is thin at both ends (L0: 2, L1: 8, L2: 168, L3: 976; L13-L15: 55,936). The empty goban IS bracketed at 4x4 (B [1,16], W [-16,-1], width 15). Deep-tangle entries (width >= 24 of 32) concentrate at L6-L12.
findings.measurement: 4x4 (wzo2, 48,505,262 fresh-start entries): total fresh-start bracket entries 1,962,142; positions 1,913,925 (7.87% of 24,318,165); per-layer L15:1,856 L14:8,424 L13:45,656 L12:153,030 L11:321,312 L10:434,904 L9:420,368 L8:304,472 L7:167,920 L6:72,520 L5:24,344 L4:6,182 L3:976 L2:168 L1:8 L0:2. Width stats: mean 13.28, max 32; width>=24 counts L6-L12 band (peak L10:22,608). 3x3: 3,204 entries / 2,984 positions (23.5%); L0 certified (0 brackets). 4x3 (engine fixpoint): 54,074 entries / 635,190 checked (8.51%); L0:2 (empty 4x3 bracketed, 100% of its 2 slots), near-terminal L11: 948 of 3,128 (30.3% — the capture-reopening signature band).
findings.controls: 4x4 totals reproduce T380's census exactly (1,962,142 / 1,913,925 / 7.8704% / width mean 13.28).

findings.question: cost (b): does resolving a layer shrink the next? (the operator's core optimism)
findings.verdict: measurement — YES, dramatically, at both 3x3 and 4x3: 3 rounds, 85.8%/94.9% of the bracket region certified by propagation without any direct resolution
findings.claim: The layered re-convergence (pin a layer's brackets to PSK values, re-run Pass 2) certifies the great majority of the remaining bracket region for free, and the rate IMPROVES with goban size (85.8% -> 94.9% of bracket entries never need a direct solve at 3x3 -> 4x3).
findings.measurement: 3x3: round 0 = 3,204 brackets; round 1 pins L8 (200) -> 448 propagated, remaining 2,556; round 2 pins L7 (168) -> 1,624 propagated, remaining 764; round 3 pins L6 (88) -> 676 propagated, remaining 0. Direct pins 456 (14.2%), propagated 2,748 (85.8%). 4x3: round 0 = 54,074; round 1 pins L11 (948) -> 6,932 propagated; round 2 pins L10 (864) -> 25,864 propagated; round 3 pins L9 (944) -> 18,522 propagated; remaining 0. Direct pins 2,756 (5.1%), propagated 51,318 (94.9%). Shrink is structurally non-increasing (pinned values lie inside [L,H], so L rises, H falls, certified stays certified); the MEASURED content is the rate, which is fast: every unresolved bracket layer collapses within the next re-convergence at both sizes.
findings.controls: each round's re-convergence terminates with L>H = 0; the 3x3 round-0 histogram equals the wzo2 layer census (t386_layers) exactly.

findings.question: cost (c) — NEW: is the propagation PSK-exact?
findings.verdict: measurement — NO: 80/2,748 (3x3) and 496/51,318 (4x3) propagated positions are certified to the WRONG value; exactness needs verify-then-pin
findings.claim: Propagation certifies positions 'for free' but not always to their PSK fresh-start value. The drifters are all bracketed-at-round-0 and almost all divergent-at-round-0 (80/80 at 3x3; 456/496 at 4x3), live in the propagation-certified bands, and err symmetrically (40/40 up/down at 3x3; 248/248 at 4x3) — the construction is not systematically pro- or anti-Black. Pinning the drifters (1 extra round at each size) makes the final table EXACTLY the PSK oracle (0 mismatches at all 24,330 / 635,190 checked slots), with no cascade.
findings.measurement: 3x3: FINAL-VERIFY mismatch-vs-PSK = 80 (0.33% of 24,330 slots; 2.9% of the 2,748 propagated), all at L4-L6 (16/16/48), all bracketed AND divergent at round 0. Phase 2: 1 round, 80 pins, 0 remaining mismatches. 4x3: mismatch = 496 (0.078% of 635,190; 0.97% of 51,318), at L6-L9 (16/144/144/192), 456 divergent-at-r0 (40 not). Phase 2: 1 round, 496 pins, 0 remaining. Total exact-resolution cost: 536 of 3,204 brackets (16.7%) at 3x3; 3,252 of 54,074 (6.0%) at 4x3.
findings.controls: phase 2 terminates with the construction equal to the PSK oracle entry-for-entry; the phase-2 pins' provenance is checked against the round-0 L/H snapshot.

findings.question: intractability scoping: does GLOBAL.R1 transfer to the proposal?
findings.verdict: finding — R1's specific number does not transfer, but the per-root PSK-solve wall at 4x4 does; the proposal inherits it, and the layered order meets the worst roots first
findings.claim: R1 (118,475,182 ban-set states on the empty 2x2, whole-game root solve) measures FULL-HISTORY enumeration from the root. The proposal is not that: it resolves bracketed roots with certified/pinned boundary values, and the measured 3x3/4x3 experiments show bracket-collapse in 3 rounds. BUT the per-root forward PSK solve at 4x4 is the project's measured wall (sound path: capture-reopening roots at near-terminal layers blow 500M-node budgets, 3-6 min each — scaling-census; 4x4 PSK sample: 782/1,591 roots budget-excluded at 200K nodes — T380 F-6; Exact solver unusable at 5.4 MB/memo key), and at 4x4 the DEEPEST bracketed layers (L13-L15: 55,936 entries) are exactly the capture-reopening band the finisher measured as explosive — the deepest-first layered order resolves those FIRST.
findings.measurement: 4x4 layer census: L13-L15 fresh-start bracket entries 45,656+8,424+1,856 = 55,936 (2.85% of the bracket region); the finisher's measured blowups were at exactly this band (scaling-census: 'near-terminal layer 15 (one empty point), a few ko-sensitive roots blow the 500M budget'). An alternative shallowest-first order would resolve the opening band first (L0-L3: 1,154 entries total — small), making the deep-layer searches cheaper by pinning their capture-children — but then the empty goban (width-15 bracket, the R1-class root) is resolved first. Either order, the per-root PSK solve at 4x4 is the wall; the layered construction reduces the COUNT of solves (F-4/F-5) but not their per-solve difficulty.
findings.controls: the 3x3/4x3 experiments give the count side of the ledger at two sizes; the per-solve cost side rests on the cited existing measurements (scaling-census, T380 F-6, retrograde-4x4).

findings.question: soundness: does adopting full PSK dissolve GLOBAL.F1?
findings.verdict: finding — F1 is dissolved only by making unsafe reuse impossible, which is the expensive path; the layered pinning does not carry the F1 hazard but has its own failure mode
findings.claim: F1 is a memo-reuse discipline bug (a score computed under one history reused at another arrival; the ko_ref >= d guard insufficient). Adopting full PSK does not fix the guard — under PSK the memo key would need the full ban set (5.4 MB/key at 4x4 — infeasible), so the forward search is writes-off by necessity: the unsafe reuse class becomes unreachable (the F1 bug evaporates) but the search becomes the sound path, which is the capture-reopening wall (F-6). Separately, the layered construction's PINNING is not a search-memo reuse at all — pins are fixpoint constants (the graft's definition) — so it carries no F1-class hazard; its failure mode is value-infidelity of the propagation (F-5), detectable only by comparing against the PSK value, which requires the solve.
findings.measurement: no new run needed: the argument rests on F-5 (drifters need oracle comparison to be caught) and the cited memo-key cost (T380: 5.4 MB per memo key at 4x4).

notes: All instruments are additive (src/t386_*.zig); no engine, artifact, axiom, build.zig or data/ file touched (git diff clean apart from the four new src files). Runs executed directly (ReleaseFast binaries, peak RSS 866 MB for the 4x4 census, 208 MB for 4x3 shrink — no runner breach). Every denominator is stated per line. Projections to 4x4 (shrink rate, solve count) are LABELLED AS PROJECTIONS in the ADR: the 3x3/4x3 rates do not transfer by per-goban independence; they bound the plausible band (6-17% of bracket entries need direct resolution). The 4x4 layer census and bracket counts are MEASURED, not projected. Landmark: advances L2 (proven 4x4 values) by measuring whether the proposed cycle-resolution route can produce them and at what cost; the answer is 'count-cheap, per-solve-walled' with the exactness caveat (F-5).
